adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `poll_feed` runs hourly and does `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` then iterates `rss.items.each` with no limit/cursor/etag/last-modified handling, so it will re-scan and re-parse the entire feed each run (O(N) work). However, the finding overstates impact: `TopicEmbed.import` computes `content_sha1` and skips `PostRevisor` unless the SHA changes, so it *does* have per-item change detection and won’t necessarily cause N revisions when unchanged.
